text:
Type: woven water hyacinth plant pot
Use: covering a potted plant on a floor or a shelf; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: bohemian, coastal, rustic
Materials: woven water hyacinth over a white plastic inner liner
Colors: greyish brown, warm taupe, white liner
Shape: round tapered cachepot with a chunky braided weave and a rolled braided rim, thick textured surface, medium visual weight
Feel: natural, warm, earthy, relaxed
Goes with: green leafy plants, light or dark wood, linen, jute rugs; bohemian, coastal or rustic rooms
